rare_earths.scope: Rare earth metals (including scandium and yttrium), cerium compounds and other rare earth compounds. Tonnes of traded product, not contained rare earth oxide. Excludes ores and finished magnets. Customs records do not state the transport mode, so routes are modelled as container shipping between main ports, or rail and road between neighbours with open borders; some high-value lots travel by air.
